frame: Shared by model.stl and parts/*.stl. X = body axis (head toward +X), Y = wing span (left wing +Y, right wing -Y), Z = up, z = 0 is the print bed.

parts.name: body
parts.description: head, eyes, antennae, thorax, segmented abdomen, plus the 2 pins with their webs

parts.name: left_wing
parts.description: left fore + hind wing (+Y side) with C-ring bore

parts.name: right_wing
parts.description: right fore + hind wing (-Y side) with C-ring bore, mirror of the left wing

joints.name: left_wing_hinge
joints.angle_convention: right-hand rotation of the child about axis through origin, 0 = neutral pose as exported
joints.axial_retention: pin has a 50-deg bottom flare (blocks -Z) and a 50-deg countersunk head (blocks +Z); the bore is the pin profile shifted 0.5 mm outward, so axial play is only 0.6 mm; the C-ring wraps 246 deg so the pin cannot leave sideways

joints.name: right_wing_hinge
joints.angle_convention: right-hand rotation of the child about axis through origin, 0 = neutral pose as exported
joints.axial_retention: pin has a 50-deg bottom flare (blocks -Z) and a 50-deg countersunk head (blocks +Z); the bore is the pin profile shifted 0.5 mm outward, so axial play is only 0.6 mm; the C-ring wraps 246 deg so the pin cannot leave sideways
